description: DEEP, SPOTLESS CLEANING: The specially formulated Formula 1 Carnauba Wash and Wax has a thick, rich foam that cleans deeply. It washes not only the car's surface but also reaches deep into its recesses to remove bugs, tough dirt, tar, and road grime. HIGH GLOSS SHINE: After washing your car, this premium grade wax leaves behind a durable shine that lasts a long time. The glossy finish gives you excellent water-beading protection, which makes maintaining your spotless wash easy. Rest assured that your vehicle will look sleek and polished, even after it rains. EASY TO USE: In a bucket, add 1 ounce of the Wash and Wax to 4 liters of water. Using a soft cloth or mitt, pour the mix on your car. Wash your vehicle section by section, starting with the top of the car. Rinse the car with clean water and wipe it dry. It's that easy! PROTECTS AS IT CLEANS: This special wash not only acts as a cleaning agent - it also guards your car from dirt and damage. After washing your car with Formula 1 a protective layer of carnauba will shield your car from dirt and grime. MUST HAVE FOR CAR LOVERS: Simple to use and very efficient, the Carnauba Wash and Wax gives your car a complete visual overhaul. Unlike liquid or powder household detergents, Formula 1 is easy to wash off and won't harm or dull your vehicle's paint finish. Your car, truck, SUV or motorcycle will look brand new and showroom ready after a thorough cleaning with Formula 1 Carnauba Wash and Wax Made in USA
